# The Support Machine

> A book and practical skills for deploying and operating AI customer support without breaking trust.

v0.3 review edition, November 1, 2026. 29 chapters, five appendices. The public site shows the deployed edition until this revision is published.

## Read

- [Full book](https://assafbar2.github.io/the-support-machine/downloads/the-support-machine-v0.3.md)
- [Online book](https://assafbar2.github.io/the-support-machine/book.html)
- [PDF](https://assafbar2.github.io/the-support-machine/the-support-machine-v0.3.pdf)

## Apply

- [The Support Machine skill](https://github.com/assafbar2/the-support-machine/tree/main/skills/the-support-machine)
- [Support AI Evals skill](https://github.com/assafbar2/the-support-machine/tree/main/skills/support-ai-evals)

In a local checkout, use skills/the-support-machine/SKILL.md for the full migration and operating model. Use skills/support-ai-evals/SKILL.md for continuing QA and the local cohort calculator. Each is independently installable. Before merge, v0.3 lives on codex/support-machine-v0.3.

Keep reported resolution, reviewed quality, and later customer evidence separate. Use mature observation windows and declared coverage. No observed return is not proof of success. Verify account authority and action effects. A valid objection can save a launch. Keep a tested human path, owned repairs, and controlled knowledge releases.

The canonical formatted source is the current DOCX in manuscript/. Book Markdown and site downloads are derived. See CONTRIBUTING.md for the generation workflow. Manuscript text is CC BY 4.0; skills, templates, and scripts are MIT.
